notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 changelog
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Changed the way cat placement is detected 📦
[*] You can now rotate the held cat both ways 🐈
[*] Corrected some bugs related to DLC detection 🛋
[*] Less controller vibrations, though it still purrs occasionally 😸
[*] After placing the cat in the wrong spot it no longer comes back to where it was last placed. Instead, the camera shakes and you can try again 🎮
[/list]

notes.title: Purring and meowing – here it is – the release date of Fit My Cat on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2]Here they come! The feline siege of the cardboard box is about to begin on a full PC scale. Fit My Cat is heading to the Steam platform with a battle "meow"! The feline army will launch its assault on August 23![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136357/33d226a9b4ac7e924b41956c9df4ae15b6dc82fd.png[/img]

Fit My Cat is a popular cat puzzle game from RedDeer.Games. Here, the player’s main task is, it would seem, remarkably simple – to fit a group of kittens in a cardboard box in such a way that each of them finds its perfect spot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136357/450100a2b935dd14b3d0012dc75cdcd374fe8868.png[/img]

However! There are a bunch of kittens and the box has its limitations. In addition, each kitten is a different size and shape, so players will have to arrange them appropriately in the provided space. A lot of box space will also be taken by some extra obstacles, for example – cat toys.

There will be 90 boards of varying difficulty waiting for players to solve. This gives – assuming that on average there are 6 cats on the board – as many as 555 kittens waiting for their dream of a cardboard box to come true! 

In addition, all this kitten-fitting happens with a dynamic soundtrack playing in the background!

[previewyoutube=nt9iX9RDEdg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Fit My Cat will be available on Steam from August 23. The game is now available on Nintendo Switch and Xbox. The animal puzzle games also come in "wild" – Fit My Zoo and "canine" – Fit My Dog versions, both released on the Nintendo Switch consoles!

Wishlist the game right meow! [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128520/Fit_My_Cat/
